'''Christian LaPointe''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 61 from Ottawa, ON, whose slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He played from the game's release and ran a league in Ottawa.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
